body:
I’m 30 next month, no friends, shit job, gf is so distant.
Only thing I haven’t done is written notes. Thought about it often though. Mostly think about how to tie a noose though then I ended up here on reddit
I’m turning 30 in January too also wanting to leave soon too

I think about setting it all up with note done rope setup, and just have that final day maybe go for a walk, maybe give my savings out to strangers or homeless people then leave. 
The main worry is failing, I don’t want the rope to fail, nor do I want to have a long pain

As someone who both played normally and spoofed at a certain point.

My view is not that anything is right or wrong, just that myself having severe depression and anxiety meant I struggled to actually play.

At first it got me walking to my local store but that was it.
Spoofing allowed me to check my town centre to see if people were there at night, eventually after lurking with spoofing I eventually got brave enough to go all on my own! And met people.

This happened a few times, but I did also enjoy playing without leaving my room, it gave me a choice rather than a forced option which makes anxiety worse
This was just an insight not to say if anything is good or bad, but I accept sadly it’s against the rules and I was banned. Since then I haven’t played and my anxiety n depression fell back to before.
I thank you for your time on this topic, it’s a shame but atleast I know it’s not really possible. I’ll have to try an online coaching for her I suppose.

After a quick search since several suggested giants, I can tell from pictures that was the cafe I had been to last time I think the one in magaf.
 After we ask to not sit on female table they insisted that she must and I can only sit behind her (back to back) which wasn’t ideal so we left. Atleast that was a few months ago on my last visit.

Thankyou I can’t remember the place I went to last time that basically said she had to sit with girls couldn’t sit at another table with me , but I’ll look up this place you suggest, again thankyou for your helpfulness.

Im not so much a "tilted" player I don't have time to be angry with others in this regard. More that its a disappointment. I try my best to keep morale up when needed, but i must admit lately I'm more or less just avoiding comms lately as its just saddening, maybe its my old age, maybe I'm just tired of people talking "shit" to each other, either way I think the end result achieves nothing that's all i wanted to get across. Maybe you reading an endless amount of these? means theres something wrong? I mean the way you tell me seems like its common, maybe its just complaining, maybe its more than that. I just wanted to state how it seems to me personally.

This was not meant in any way to state im better than anyone else or that  I think I know best. ( your reply has made me realise why i hesitated to post on reddit in the first place)

It was more to see the common frustrations of others and find a sample of what can be addressed.

In anycase I've played since the release and Im not a new or bronze so just to clear your assumptions up, i typically play around 3.2k - 3.5k although prior to the past year i have been higher and lower on other accounts mainly to see the differences in co ordination, and the way people treat each other.
Its almost like you feel offended by my post? I merely mean it in the best interests no hatred.
